verdict.rationale: Mintlify docs confirm generation of interactive API reference pages from OpenAPI spec files with automatic endpoint pages and navigation (mintlify-docs-14), and docs.json centralizes API settings (mintlify-docs-16/27), implying updates propagate when config/spec changes. However, there is no explicit evidence of automatic re-sync/watch behavior when the underlying OpenAPI spec file changes (e.g., CI hooks, webhook-triggered regeneration) beyond the CLI's local preview/build tools. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or demonstration of automatic sync/rebuild triggered by OpenAPI spec updates (e.g., CI/CD pipeline, webhook, or live-reload on spec change), independent/hands-on confirmation of spec-drift handling.
